Early Voting ends tomorrow and Tuesday is final day.  Georgia Get To The Polls.


rolandsmartin (@rolandsmartin)

If you are 18-39, PAY ATTENTION! Y’all are a larger group than baby boomers and Gen Xers. Y’all complain about older people in politics. But look at what Georgia NAACP President Gerald Griggs posted. Of the 696,353 people that have voted early in Georgia, only 9.8% are 18-39. That is abysmal. You can’t change the system if you never show up at the ballot box. Expressing anger on Thre

Please let this be true!!!!

It isn't just on black folks to solve this, every ethnic demographic that does not want this, everyone who believes in equality and democracy needs to get out and vote these clowns out of office. We stand together to end racist politicians abusing power.

Great Leader as Well.  Has not polled well but a great leader.  He too can lead this state for sure

Keisha Lance Bottoms wants to be Georgia's next Governor: Keisha Lance Bottoms, former mayor of Atlanta, aims to become Georgia's first Black and female governor, emphasizing her leadership experience. Read more: bit.ly/4dFwf3r

All Black Community In Atlanta mixed income


DerekJMiller (@DerekJMiller2)

I thought you were smarter than that. That’s the way it already is.  Where do you live Mr. multimillionaire in a high crime area in the hood? I’m guessing no

Shed Jackson 🙋🏻‍♂️ (@iShedJ)

Regardless of political affiliation, moments involving voting access, representation, and redistricting deserve serious public engagement and scrutiny. Silence has never been a strong #civic strategy…

@theswagshopedgewood has always been about more than cuts — it’s about community. Atlanta helped us establish roots, and now we’re honoring those same values as we grow. Big love to @Square for being part of the journey. #ad

I woke up with ‘Mania on my Mind. This beat is so cold I had to kill it. Don’t trip Cody, minor setback for a major comeback and congrats to Jey for getting his first World Title! Inspired By Old Atlanta & TBS! #wrestling #codyrhodes #jeyuso #rap #atlanta
Had to get bro right before his show in the A tomorrow @Tommy Richman
To laugh at another man’s fault is to make their same mistake yourself..#addiction #killamike #runthejewels
